Cc: sally.tran@novation.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding / initial PO request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To keep us moving on implementation, can you confirm how the provisional PO number will be issued and whether Novation can start provisioning against a tentative spend cap while procurement approves the final contract?

Quick context: our initial order is a mix of monthly credits and a one-time integration fee. The finance team needs a PO or provisional reference for June billing to avoid delayed invoicing. Also, one of the line items (SKU: NOV-INTG-01) was entered as quantity 10 in our intake form but should be 1 — can that be corrected before the PO is finalized?

I've attached the filled onboarding form and the intake spreadsheet.

Attachments: novation_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf), intake_items.csv (csv)

Best,
Ethan
VP, Partnerships — Novation AI
From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Lopez <ethan.lopez@novation.ai>, sally.tran@novation.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding / initial PO request

Hi Ethan — thanks for the form and the heads-up on the SKU. We're able to issue a provisional PO reference to unblock June invoicing while legal finishes the final SOW sign-off.

Plan: 
- I'll kick off a provisional PO in our ledger and attach a provisional PO PDF you can use for invoices (we label these PROV-PO until the final PO is issued).
- Monica (cc'd) will confirm the spend cap that Finance is comfortable exposing for external provisioning.
- Markus (cc'd) — can procurement correct the SKU quantity for NOV-INTG-01 from 10 to 1 in the intake record and include a short fix log? We want the provisional PO to reflect the corrected line item.

Ethan, we'll send the provisional PO and the ledger reference by tomorrow EOD PST. Quick Q: do you need the PO number mirrored in your accounting system field PurchaseRef or is the PDF sufficient?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Alex / Monica — noted. I updated the intake record and created a short CSV log describing the correction: NOV-INTG-01 quantity changed 10 -> 1, reason: intake typo, corrected by Markus K.

Procurement steps taken:
- Corrected SKU quantity in onboarding database (record ID ONB-20260623-8342).
- Provisionally reserved spend cap: $45,000 (this covers the first 3 months of expected usage and the one-time integration fee).
- Drafted provisional PO reference: PROV-8342-20260625. Attached provisional_po_8342.pdf for vendor use.

Monica — please confirm the $45k provisional cap is OK to share with Novation so they can provision. If Finance needs a lower cap, we can reduce but will note impact on burst/billing.

Markus
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachments: provisional_po_8342.pdf, lineitem_fix_log.csv
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Thanks team — confirming the provisional spend cap of $45,000 is approved for provisioning only. Please note: 
- This cap is provisional until Finance has the signed SOW and P-card authorization; any consumption beyond provisional cap will require explicit escalation to billing@redwood.ai.
- Novation: the attached PROV-8342-20260625 PDF is the reference to use when submitting June invoices. Please update your accounting entry to PurchaseRef = PROV-8342-20260625.

Ethan — once you receive the final PO after sign-off we'll retroactively reconcile the provisional charges. If you want, schedule a 15-minute sync with me next week to walk through invoicing fields.

Best,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
